g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
line `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on
this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…\n- [Get run status](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-run-status.md): Run status, result, and summary. Poll until `status` is terminal
(`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `timed_out`). `grading` is not terminal — every trial has finished and the run is held for
its gating judge, with `result` still `pending` — so keep polling.\n- [Get a run's decision summary](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-decision-summary.md): The canonical, versioned run decision contract: the verdict and where it came
from, the counts with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision when it has one, and one page of per-trial diagnos
tics carrying the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evidence s…\n- [Compare a run against a baseline
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md): Compare this run against a baseline run: p
er-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer pass-rate and mean deltas from the evalua
tion contract, and whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare against the nearest earlier **completed**…\n
- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual too
l calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.\n- [Get an iteration trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
eval-runs/get-an-iteration-trace.md): Full trace envelope for one iteration: conversation messages, expected-vs-actual tool call a
nalysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may evolve — treat it as an open document. Returns `404` with `details.reason: \"TRACE_N
OT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteration's step results](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iterations-step-results.md): One row per authored test step, in order, with `status` (`ok`/`fail`/`s
kipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls). The fastest way to see w
hich step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404` — step verdicts still ret…\n- [Cancel a run](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-run.md): Request cancellation of an in-flight run; marks the run and its pending/run
ning iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `grading` for its gating judge CAN be cancelled — it lands `cancelled` with no verdict,
which is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run is alrea…\n- [Preview a failed-cases rerun]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{run
Id}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform selects every case with a trial that
is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` count trials; `selectedCase…\n-
[Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-failed-cases.md): Replay a finished run'
s frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and passed (cancelled and
skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases — see the rerun preview. The new run records `rerunOfRunId` and `rer
unScope`, and beca…\n- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs f
or a suite, newest first.\n- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suite
s-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out o
f the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginall
y by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-stage
-analytics.md): ONE run's materialized stage-analytics document: where its trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (conn
ection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get o
ne run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ON
E run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoi
nt, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md)
: A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments.
Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALID
ATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target — attached project environments, or attach
ed named hosts — under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution and responds `202` with a per-target recei
pt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-aut
hor-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` **synchronous
ly**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suit
eId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-own
ed-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declared
SuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; th
is body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution conf
ig, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.\n- [Delete an e
val suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs ar
e not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings
.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null`
clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the fu
ll updated suite.\n- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-
pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and wh
ere they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subproc
essors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…\n- [List a suite's eval cases](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n-
[Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `t
itle` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a cas
e persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n- [Create se
veral eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite
